title: Mabye Positive Pack
description: Very Very Cheap Good PvP Texture Pack.
body:
# Mabye Positive Pack

A clean and optimized resource pack designed to improve visibility, comfort, and gameplay without changing Minecraft's vanilla style.

## ✨ Features

* Brighter environments for easier exploration.
 ![Comparison](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/8earkiWo/images/e2e257ab8a0882b7a5c4aae8f3ed06d0787e9682.png)
* Clearer glass and underwater visibility.
*  ![Glass Boat](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/X2XuCI6o/images/645ad1a44abd166e68bdb614d7372fdc35ec1532_350.webp)
* More visible ores in dark areas.
*  ![Better Ores Visibility](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/qfYE1L5z/images/9cb80a0c9cd0a62208c7b1e7e271203b7379e6e7_350.webp)
* Better scaffold visibility.
*  ![Better scaffold visibility](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/R4qecDWj/images/f5142bac47c4a8167500cd95c839873aa65e6931_350.webp)
* Reduced fire overlay.
* Lower grass for a wider field of view.
* No fog for maximum visibility.
* ![Fog Comparison](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/TpgnS5jX/images/a8f5a8bba98887f12a74ae33240f1a606ae62b63.png)
* No cave ambience sounds.
* ![No Cave Sound](https://i.imgur.com/Fdy0WmZ.png)
* No pumpkin overlay.
* Cleaner shield appearance.
* Improved visibility for:

  * Food (with eating animation)
  * Totems
  * Fire Charges
  * Fireworks
  * Potions
  * Compasses
  * Clocks
  * Ender Pearls
  * And many more items.
* Smaller pop animation for totems.

## 🎮 Perfect for

* Survival
* PvP
* Speedrunning
* Hardcore
* Exploration
* Building

## 📦 Compatibility

Works with vanilla Minecraft and most servers. No gameplay mechanics are modified—only textures, sounds, and visual effects are improved for a cleaner experience.

Enjoy Minecraft with better visibility, less visual clutter, and a more comfortable experience while keeping the original vanilla aesthetic.
